title: Tastatur wird ausgeschaltet bzw." Unbrauchbar" gemacht nach dem installieren MS Power Toys, schade. Bei mein 2ten PC lässt sich es gar nicht mehr deinstallieren

judgment.rationale: The reporter gives PowerToys 0.90.0, GitHub installation, and Keyboard Manager as the area, but the only reproduction text translates to PowerToys being switched off followed by a restart. Expected and actual behavior are blank, and the uninstall failure on the second PC is not described. The current evidence cannot distinguish a keyboard remap from a separate installation/removal problem.
evidence: The issue body reports two computers and says the second cannot be uninstalled.
The steps field contains only “Power Toys abgeschaltet + Neustart”; no expected/actual behavior is supplied.
The live issue is open with Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-Keyboard Manager labels; no comments or assignees are present.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the exact keyboard symptom and the separate uninstall error before assigning a code path.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report is too underspecified to establish that a PowerToys code change is applicable; the uninstall problem may be a separate installer issue.

issue_context.summary: The report mentions an unusable keyboard after a restart with PowerToys switched off and a separate inability to uninstall on another PC, but does not state what failed on either computer.
known_information: PowerToys version is reported as 0.90.0, installed from GitHub, with the reporter running as administrator.
The selected area is Keyboard Manager.
The issue is open, has no comments, and has no assignee.
inferences: The keyboard behavior and the uninstall problem may have different causes and should be triaged separately.
issue_context.analysis: The missing symptom and uninstall error prevent a useful code hypothesis. A focused clarification is more discriminating than requesting logs or a generic bug report.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live issue body and confirmed there are no comment pages to inspect.
Checked live labels, assignees, and timeline references; no linked work or pull request was found.
No owning source path can be selected until the keyboard failure and uninstall failure are described independently.

information_gaps.information: What exact keyboard behavior fails on each PC, and the numbered steps from enabling or disabling Keyboard Manager to observing it.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes a remapping/hook problem from a keyboard or PowerToys startup problem.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Describe one failing PC at a time, including the key pressed, expected result, actual result, and whether the same key works after Keyboard Manager is disabled.

information_gaps.information: The exact uninstall method and visible error on the second PC, plus whether that installation is per-user or machine-wide.
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether the second symptom belongs to Keyboard Manager or to installer/removal handling.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: State whether removal was attempted from Windows Installed apps, PowerToys settings, or the original installer, and quote the visible error.

comment.body:
Thanks for reporting PowerToys 0.90.0, the GitHub installation, and that the second PC also cannot be uninstalled. The current steps say only “PowerToys switched off + restart,” and the expected/actual fields are blank, so we cannot tell whether the keyboard symptom and uninstall failure share a cause.

Please provide:
1. For each affected PC, the exact key or keyboard behavior that fails, the numbered steps that trigger it, and what changes when Keyboard Manager is disabled.
2. For the second PC, how you attempted to uninstall PowerToys (Windows Installed apps, PowerToys settings, or the installer) and the exact error shown; also say whether it was installed per-user or for all users.

This will determine whether the keyboard report belongs to Keyboard Manager and whether the separate removal failure needs installer triage.
